# Book of Giants Fragment 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 4Q203 frag. 8 (Cave 4) | **Condition:** fragmentary; divine decree partially legible

---

**8:1** [...] Then God sent-word [...] by-the-hand-of Raphael [...]

**8:2** [...] the-angel who-is-over the-spirits [...]

**8:3** [...] and-over the-healing-of the-earth [...]

**8:4** [...] to-bind Azazel hand-and-foot [...]

**8:5** [...] and-to-cast-him into-the-darkness [...]

**8:6** [...] to Shemihazah and-to-all his-companions [...]

**8:7** [...] who-took wives from the-daughters-of men [...]

**8:8** [...] and-defiled-themselves with-them [...]

**8:9** [...] in-all their-uncleanness [...]

**8:10** [...] the-decree-of God has-gone-forth [...]

**8:11** [...] everything that Azazel has-done: he-has-taught all unrighteousness on-the-earth [...]

**8:12** [...] and-has-made-known the-forbidden-arts [...]

**8:13** [...] the-making-of swords and-weapons [...]

**8:14** [...] and-every-instrument-of death [...]

**8:15** [...] and-he-taught-them the-arts-of adornment [...]

**8:16** [...] and-has-revealed the-eternal secrets which-were in-heaven [...]

**8:17** [...] which men-were-striving to-learn [...]

**8:18** [...] and-the-knowledge-of the-clouds [...]

**8:19** [...] the-signs-of the-earth [...] and-the-signs-of the-sun [...]

**8:20** [...] and-the-course-of the-moon [...]

---

*EMET notes: Fragment 8 (Judgment Approaches). Source: 4Q203 frag. 8. Aramaic text from Cave 4 Qumran. Hyphenated compounds preserve Aramaic construct-chain syntax and bound morphemes. Square brackets indicate genuine manuscript lacunae where the leather has deteriorated or broken away. The Book of Giants is an Aramaic expansion of the Watcher myth from 1 Enoch 6-16, featuring the Nephilim giants Ohya, Hahya (sons of Shemihazah), Mahaway (son of Baraq'el), and the hero Gilgamesh.*
